name: The Fairmont Hotel Vancouver
positioning: Downtown Vancouver hotel that debuted in 1939, with art deco design touches; officially called Fairmont Hotel Vancouver
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Vancouver base near the Vancouver Art Gallery and Robson Street shopping
Travelers who like art deco style and an indoor pool

facts.text: The hotel debuted in 1939, and a visit by the British royal couple sealed its reputation.
The downtown Vancouver location is near the Vancouver Art Gallery, Granville Island, the Stanley Park Seawall and Robson Street shopping.
The rooms and suites have art deco design touches that reflect the hotel's 1930s origins.
Notch8 Restaurant & Bar serves regional fare, new favorites and classic cocktails, with an extensive wine list.
Afternoon tea at Notch8 uses rotating themed menus with pastries, savory creations and unique teas.
The hotel has an indoor swimming pool.
The fitness center has exercise equipment, a sauna and an indoor swimming pool.
Fairmont Gold guests get complimentary breakfast, evening canapes, private check-in and personalized concierge services.

considerations.text: Parking is available for an additional fee.
The pool area has no hot tub.
WhataHotel notes the heritage building may have smaller room sizes than modern hotels.
